agents.task: Perform comprehensive reconnaissance on http://host.docker.internal:4180. Map the attack surface: discover all endpoints, parameters, forms, APIs, and technology stack. Use tools like httpx, katana, and ffuf for enumeration. Create a detailed map of the application structure. Once complete, derive a threat model using save_threat_model for the target.

entries.risk_area: General attack surface mapping and technology identification
entries.evidence: Complete enumeration performed. Application is a static site served by Python's SimpleHTTP/0.6 (Python 3.12.10). No backend APIs, authentication endpoints, database connections, or server-side processing found. Only static HTML, CSS, JS, and vendor libraries (Three.js r170, GSAP 3.12.5, Lenis) are served. Directory listings enabled for /vendor/, /vendor/three/, /vendor/gsap/, /vendor/lenis/, /js/, /docs/.

Directory listings enabled on /vendor/, /vendor/three/, /vendor/gsap/, /vendor/lenis/, /js/, /docs/ exposing full file tree and library versions. Server header discloses Python 3.12.10 and SimpleHTTP/0.6. No CSP or other security headers.

No Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy headers present in server responses. Server header reveals Python version.
Covered by vuln-0001 (Directory Listings Enabled). Version exposure is a consequence of the directory listing misconfiguration. No separate CVE confirmed for Three.js r170, GSAP 3.12.5, or Lenis.

Path traversal attempts (`/../../../etc/passwd`, `/../../../../etc/passwd`, URL-encoded variants) all returned 404. Python's http.server normalizes paths and prevents directory traversal outside the serving directory. The specific control is path normalization in `http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.translate_path()` which resolves paths relative to the working directory and rejects attempts to escape.
